decisions.diagnosis: Afternoon dropout ending in a single dumped slot: both directions read 0 from 15:00 to 19:45 except 17:15, which holds several thousand bikes, most likely counts accumulated over earlier outages; they cannot be placed in time, so the whole window is missing.
decisions.evidence: 17:15 slot = 3879 N and 3685 S (usual 11 and 22); day totals 4305/3987 vs ~500; zeros either side of it.

decisions.diagnosis: Afternoon dropout with a dump of 1544 bikes in the 15:00 slot followed by zeros to 20:00; the dumped counts cannot be placed in time.
decisions.evidence: 15:00 slot 1544 (usual 13), then 0 to 20:00; day total 1802 vs ~500.

decisions.diagnosis: Counter stopped mid-morning and read (almost) 0 in both directions until the evening while bikes passed.
decisions.evidence: Hours 10-19 sum to 1-4 per direction after a 116-bike 8am hour; day 351 vs 1065 at 542 (usual ratio ~0.9-1).

decisions.diagnosis: Counter dropout in both directions through the day (dry day).
decisions.evidence: North 0 from 09:00 to 19:00 except 3 bikes; South ~1 bike/hour 09-16 and 12/9 in the 17-18 peak (usual ~100); day ratio to 542 0.29.

decisions.diagnosis: Counter read 0 in both directions for 18 hours from Saturday morning; rain alone does not zero a busy cycleway.
decisions.evidence: 0 from 10:15 to 04:30 next day in both directions (usual ~400 each); day 201 vs 1117 at 542; 2020-03-08 normal.

decisions.diagnosis: Counter dropout in both directions from the morning peak into the afternoon.
decisions.evidence: North 0 from 07:30 to 14:30, South 0-2 per hour 08:00-14:00 (usual ~300/100 bikes).

decisions.diagnosis: Counter dropout in both directions through the day (dry day).
decisions.evidence: 0-1 bikes per hour 08:15-16:45 in both directions, then a normal PM peak; day 826 vs 1881 at 542.

decisions.diagnosis: Counter read 0 in both directions for all of 25 April 2023 (Anzac Day), while 542 counted normally.
decisions.evidence: 0 all day both directions; 542 had 1309; normal counts on 24 and 26 April.

decisions.diagnosis: Counter 225 failed: seven weeks of all-zero (status good) records while Bourke St S of Taylor Sq (542) counted normally.
decisions.evidence: 0 bikes every week 2019-10-28 to 2019-12-08 vs ~10,000/week at 542; resumes at normal level 14 Dec.

decisions.diagnosis: Counter 225 failed: nearly six weeks of all-zero records while 542 counted normally.
decisions.evidence: 0 bikes every week 2020-12-14 to 2021-01-17 vs 5,400-10,300/week at 542; resumes mid-day 21 Jan at normal level.

decisions.diagnosis: Counter 225 failed: 16 weeks of zero records (mostly flagged warning) while 542 counted normally.
decisions.evidence: 34 bikes in the week of 1 May then 0 every week to 13 Aug vs ~10,000/week at 542; resumes 19 Aug at normal level.

decisions.diagnosis: On about 40 days from Apr 2022 to Nov 2024 the feed repeats every record of a slot (8 records instead of 4), doubling those days.
decisions.evidence: duplicates(): every extra record exactly repeats another in all 96 slots of each flagged day; doubled() level ~1.3-2.6 on those days; e.g. 2024-10-10 slot 32 N = [0,0,13,13,0,0,9,9].

series.name: Northbound (Metrocount 2025-)
series.evidence: Replacement counter after a 5.5-month gap reads ~20-25% higher than the old one in the same months of year (Nov 2024 839/day vs Nov 2025 1039/day); against nearby 158 and 168 the ratio shifts inconsistently (+~10-15% vs 158, about flat vs 168), so comparability is unsettled and it is kept as a separate series.

series.name: Southbound (Metrocount 2025-)
series.evidence: As for northbound: replacement counter with an unsettled level change after a gap, kept separate.

proposals: Redistribute dumped counts: where a counter reports 0 for hours and then one slot holds the accumulated total (554 on 2017-10-13 17:15 and 2018-01-29 15:00), an action could spread the dumped total over the preceding zero slots in proportion to the direction's usual profile, if the dump could be shown to equal the missed counts; here the dump (7,500 bikes) exceeds one afternoon, so it spans several outages and is set missing.

useful: zeros: found the long failures and the recurring 2017-18 afternoon dropouts
duplicates/doubled: pinpointed the repeated-record days and showed every extra record repeats another
spikes + channels: showed the dump slots are one record holding thousands of bikes
compare against 542: confirmed zeros were counter faults, not closures
improve: zeros: an option to merge both directions' stretches per day into a counter-level window (counter=True requires every direction at 0, which misses partial dropouts)
compare: by='month' aggregation would help judge counter-replacement level changes
add: a tool comparing the same calendar months before and after a counter change relative to several unchanged neighbours, to judge whether a replacement reads comparably

summary: Site 554 (Bourke St, Redfern) has an Ecocounter (2016-2025) and a Metrocount replacement (Oct 2025-). The Ecocounter has three long failures reporting zeros (Oct-Dec 2019, Dec 2020-Jan 2021, May-Aug 2023), a run of afternoon dropouts Sep 2017-Mar 2018 with two dumped slots of thousands of bikes, several single-day dropouts, and ~40 days in 2022-2024 where every record is duplicated; these are set missing or de-duplicated. The replacement reads ~20% higher than the old counter and is kept as separate series.
